timeline.text: Chai Wallahs begins at Glastonbury Festival as a chai stall and herbal emporium.
Chai Wallahs opens a live music stage and becomes a home for emerging independent artists.
Si Chai and Thomas Smallwood (Toast) start Diplomats of Sound, with Joss Stone's support, to help the artists they were discovering keep going.
A busy year of tours for Nubya Garcia (North America), Theon Cross, Ozomatli ft. Chali 2na, Johnny Osbourne, Brushy One String, Maisha, Liniker e os Caramelows and Open Mike Eagle.
UK tours for The Mouse Outfit and The Allergies.
Amy True on tour across the UK and Europe, The Hempolics in London, and The Mouse Outfit back on the road this autumn.
